name: lwjgl-assimp
license_evidence: Pinned Maven POM license and Assimp upstream license
input_api: Assimp.aiImportFile(String local path, 0) with pinned macOS arm64 native artifact
family: LWJGL Java binding over native Assimp PLY importer; same Assimp parser family as C++ path
scope: ASCII PLY triangle vertex and face counts, parsed face indices

name: f3d
scope: ASCII triangle produced three parsed points and one cell
family: F3D native PLY plugin over VTK vtkPLYReader
family_note: C, C++, and Java F3D 4.0.1 bindings share the F3D native plugin and VTK 9.7.2 vtkPLYReader syntax parser.

name: sceneview-core
input_api: Files.readAllBytes(local path) passed to PlyLoader.parse(byte[], ThreeMfUnit, limits), returning PlyModel vertex count, triangle count and indices
scope: ASCII PLY triangle vertices, triangulated face and parsed indices
family: SceneView Core pure Kotlin PLY parser
family_note: The released JVM artifact exposes a callable Java bytecode API over SceneView Core’s pure Kotlin PLY reader. Project-wide interest does not measure PLY use.

name: kotlin-assimp
input_api: new Importer().readFile(local File.toURI(), 0) -> AiScene with AiMesh vertices/faces
family: Kotlin-graphics JVM Assimp port PLY importer
family_note: Pure JVM port of native Assimp with its own Kotlin PlyLoader and PlyParser; derived parser lineage is recorded separately from the existing LWJGL/native Assimp wrappers.
scope: ASCII PLY triangle, three vertices, one face, parsed indices [0,1,2]

name: boofcv-io
license_evidence: Pinned Maven POM licenses section and tagged LICENSE-2.0.txt
family: BoofCV native Java PLY mesh reader
family_note: Public BoofCV mesh API dispatches to its own PlyCodec and PlyReader, with no shared syntax reader found among the other included Java paths.
scope: ASCII triangle, three vertices, one face, parsed indices [0,1,2]

name: jzy3d-core
license_evidence: Pinned official jzy3d-all 2.2.1 parent POM licenses section (The New BSD License)
input_api: Ply.read(InputStream from local ASCII PLY file), returning List<Coord3d>
family: Jzy3d public PLY vertex API over jPLY
family_note: Published Jzy3d Core library depends on its published org.smurn:jply:0.2.1; the jPLY 0.2.0 package path is already counted in this cell. This is a separate package API but not an independent PLY syntax engine.
scope: ASCII triangle vertex positions (three vertices, second X and third Y); faces not exposed by this API
